NUTS sampling frmtmb models tmbstan: frm_sample() fit formula, brms 2.23’s default priors routes, priors stacking -explicit-first, non-centered sampling qualifying random-effect blocks. Draws carry frmtmb parameter names. full posterior method surface core’s generics brms, loo, posterior, bayesplot, rstantools, coda bridgesampling generics: log_lik(), loo(), waic(), posterior_epred(), posterior_predict(), hypothesis(), conditional_effects() draws, bayes_R2(), mcmc_plot(), rest. check_laplace() measures Laplace Wald approximations NUTS objective, centered added priors. load, package registers sampling default priors core’s get_prior() feature rows compatibility matrix, stay truthful whether package installed.
